poetryFrame.leftVertical: THE WEIGHT OF DISTANCE IS MEASURED IN COLD BREWS AND PHONE SCREENS
poetryFrame.rightVertical: WE ARE BOUND BY THE MAYHEM OF OUR CITY HEARTBEATS
poetryFrame.bottomLine: A RETURN IS ALWAYS BETTER THAN A MEMORY
sonnetLines: The threadbare comfort of a borrowed sleeve,
Holds the ghost warmth of where you used to be.
We count the hours that we must receive,
A slow, sweet ache of deep dependency.
The city breathes its electric haze,
A backdrop for the moments left unsaid.
Like coffee cooling through the passing days,
Our patience waits until the tears are shed.
You said you were warm enough to roam,
But I remember how your spirit shone.
Now time is calling us back to our home,
To where two separate lives were once known.
The journey ends beneath a single gleam,
Waking up within the shared, bright dream.
